rules: A P0 or P1 finding that violates security, tenant isolation, authority boundaries, data integrity, or the gate contract blocks merge until remediated and internally falsified.

A P2 finding blocks the current PR only when it demonstrates gate incorrectness, security-invariant failure, silent authority expansion, or failure of the learning enforcement itself; otherwise it is recorded as follow-up backlog.
Findings from the same root-cause class are remediated as one horizontal batch rather than one reviewer-comment loop at a time.
After repository-owned invariants, adversarial matrix, exact-head CI, and horizontal review are clean, routine external red-team review is limited to one final round.
A final external round with no new P0/P1 material finding closes the review loop; non-blocking residual P2/P3 findings are tracked without recursively restarting the PR.
Bootstrap limitations that cannot be self-activated by the PR may use only an exact machine-readable one-time exception with compensating controls and an explicit expiry condition.
